metadata.title: X-Kira - WhatsApp Bot
metadata.description: X-Kira WhatsApp Bot made with @whiskeysockets/baileys library. Fast, reliable, and feature-rich.

hero.title: x-kira
hero.subtitle: Automate x-kira WhatsApp experience with speed and security. Built with @whiskeysockets/baileys.

features.title: Everything you need
features.subtitle: A complete set of tools to manage your groups, media, and automation needs.

turbopack.title: Group Management
turbopack.description: Full control over your groups: kick, add, promote, demote, and automated greetings.

fonts.title: Media Processing
fonts.description: Convert stickers, download videos, and edit images directly within WhatsApp.

utilities.title: 200+ Commands
utilities.description: From utility tools to fun games, X-Kira comes packed with hundreds of built-in plugins.

shadcn.title: Baileys Integration
shadcn.description: Using @whiskeysockets/baileys for the most stable and modern WhatsApp connection.

typescript.title: Reliable & Fast
typescript.description: Optimized performance ensuring your bot responds instantly to every message.

hooks.title: 24/7 Uptime
hooks.description: Built to stay online. Deploy on any VPS or PaaS with ease and stability.

i18n.title: Multi-Language
i18n.description: Full support for English, Indonesian, and more to serve users worldwide.

middleware.title: Security First
middleware.description: Secure session handling and encrypted communication to keep your data safe.

typography.title: Advanced Owner Controls
typography.subtitle: Exclusive features for bot administrators and group owners. Complete control over your bot instance.

code.title: Powerful Plugin Engine
code.subtitle: A robust system for handling events, messages, and custom commands with ease.

v13.title: v2.0 — Baileys Migration
v13.description: Complete rewrite using @whiskeysockets/baileys for enhanced stability and speed.

v12.title: v1.5 — Plugin System
v12.description: Introduced a new modular plugin system for easier feature additions.

v11.title: v1.2 — Media Tools
v11.description: Added advanced image and video processing commands.

v10.title: v1.0 — Initial Release
v10.description: The birth of X-Kira. Basic group and utility commands.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.subtitle: Connect your WhatsApp and start automating today with X-Kira. Open source and free.

footer.description: X-Kira is a high-performance WhatsApp bot built with @whiskeysockets/baileys. Automate with confidence.
